entries.venue: Found Sound (Australian dealer), used Ovation 1612 Custom Balladeer with original hard case, fair condition
entries.note: dealer ask, not sold

viewing_check: Estimate 250-350, current bid $220 (+22% premium = about $268 all-in). Exact model not visible; looks like a Balladeer-family Ovation with onboard electronics and case. Check: bowl cracks, top lifting, neck angle, working pickup/preamp (knob and jack on bowl), frets, case latches. Model/serial label inside the soundhole is not shown, so confirm the model in person; 1111/1112 era sold roughly A$300-1,000 in 2023-26, middle ~A$500-800 when in good order. Prices are on a US marketplace so add postage to Australia and risk. Mixed-up photo 5 shows a dollhouse bedroom set, not this guitar. Dates mostly within 3 years, flat.
searches_tried: Terapeak AU: Ovation guitar (48 rows), Ovation Balladeer (none), Ovation Custom Balladeer (none), Ovation 1112 (none), Ovation acoustic USA (4 rows); Terapeak US: Ovation Balladeer (50 rows); Google Ovation Balladeer auction Australia
flip_reason: 10 close Balladeer sales on US eBay at A$304-1,032 (typical about A$500-800); local AU sales on Terapeak are scarce. Bulky with case (postage ~A$100+). Current bid $220, so needs a good-condition 1111/1112 model to net $200+. Check in person.
